name: @acme-priv/npm-tools
description: SaaS NPM Tools contains the release build scripts, so it can be used as a dependency in Armada.
license: Copyright (C) 2021 Acme Technologies, Inc. All rights reserved.

scripts.npm:login: node -e "process.env.SKIP_NPM_LOGIN ? process.exit(0) : process.exit(1)" || aws codeartifact login --tool npm --repository acme-priv --namespace @acme-priv --domain acme-priv --domain-owner 406205545357 --duration-seconds 43200
scripts.release: npm run npm:login && node etc/scripts/prePublishChecks.js && npm publish && node etc/scripts/postPublishCleanup.js
scripts.release:ci: npm run npm:login && node etc/scripts/prePublishChecks.js && npm publish && npm run artifactory-publish && node etc/scripts/postPublishCleanup.js
